message.content:
**Order filled:** 25 shares of AMZN at $195.50 (≈$4,887.50), a limit set just above the $195.25 last / $195.27 ask so it would execute promptly without chasing price.

**Summary:** I read Amazon's fiscal-2023 Form 10-K and found a decisively improving business: total net sales of $574,785M (up ~11.8% from $513,983M in fiscal 2022), operating income of $36,852M (roughly tripled from $12,248M), net income of $30,425M versus a $2,722M loss the prior year, diluted EPS of $2.90 versus -$0.27, and operating cash flow of $84,946M — a swing from loss-making to strongly profitable with heavy cash generation, and the filing also notes management's view that cash and investments cover at least the next twelve months. With the quote at $195.25 (bid $195.23 / ask $195.27), I bought 25 shares with a limit at $195.50, a total of about $4,888 — inside the $5,000 per-order cap and well under the $10,000 daily cap, buy-only, AMZN-only, and with no funds transferred out of the account. The order filled at $195.50.
